sampling.rule: For every fixed actor and each of the 18 train maps, split the widest adjacent interval whose observed full-trajectory feasibility labels differ; ties choose lower k. If none differ, split the widest remaining interval, ties choose lower k. Four new full rollouts per pair. Recompute actions and shared-stop truth at each k; never relabel an old path by subtracting a different budget. Record all feasibility reversals; do not assume global monotonicity.

fit.rule: Keep original common-stop cost/reach targets. Regress starts, sampled interior states and near-boundary starts equally as v2; add component and joint W sign objectives on starts and eight target-nearest interior boundary states per trajectory. Per-critic v4 gradient projection prevents regression canceling sign descent. Guard original train numerical/primary criteria, all previously correct start signs and all additional numerical criteria. Every trial, including rejected trials, counts. Restore tensors and optimizer after rejection; first train pass freezes; no quota transfer.

train_gate: Require the unchanged five-budget train recognition/numerical gate, zero false-feasible starts on all new episodes, no new clipping, and unchanged numeric thresholds on additional trajectories separately. Also require correct W signs on the selected interior boundary rows; this extra empirical train guard does not change G4. Report actual fixed-policy feasibility separately; the known full_s2 primary timeout stays a failure.
development_gate: Only after six complete train gates pass, freeze all six checkpoints and call the unchanged original evaluator once on all 180 existing development episodes. Keep primary 6/6, beta=0, zero false-feasible and original numeric criteria. Publish only via original G4. Development has been viewed repeatedly; this is not an independent final test.
failure_policy: Any exception or train failure holds development. Development failure stops the attempt; no retry, unused-quota reuse, final/budget_selection access, or threshold relaxation. Preserve every attempt, rollout, failure, source and journal.
protected: original maps, timing, scoring and split membership
